industry: Developer tools (AI coding-agent rules and PR checks)
fit_reason: Open-source developer tool with a public GitHub org, listed as launched on 2026-10-27, run by an Indian company; its launch page has no demo video, which MotionRepo makes from the repo.

evidence.claim: ScrollLaunch lists Groundrule (maker Ekansh Tiwari) with launch date Oct 27, 2026 and links groundrule.dev and the GitHub repo; seen 2026-10-30.

GitHub org Metricall-AI-Lab shows location India, builds Groundrule, and has 6 public repos; groundrule-oss and groundrule-action were updated Oct 29, 2026 (Apache-2.0). The page shows no releases or tags, so the update date is the only recency evidence. Seen 2026-10-30.

groundrule.dev footer credits Vyana Compute; vyanacompute.com gives Vyana Compute Private Limited, New Delhi, and describes itself as a parent company that builds and runs software companies. Team size and founders are not stated on either site (checked 2026-10-30).

On 2026-10-30 I opened groundrule.dev and found no video or embedded demo on the page (no video element, YouTube, Loom or mp4 link; only static mockups and CLI text). The GitHub README has one PNG titled 'Groundrule in 60 seconds' and no video or GIF.
The product's code is on GitHub (Apache-2.0 core, repo groundrule-oss), so MotionRepo's GitHub-only sign-in is not a blocker.
Whether the team is 2 to 20 people and founder-led is not established: Vyana Compute is a parent company, which could mean a larger studio group. Treated as a risk, not a fact.

score_rationale: India, GitHub and a 3-day-old launch confirmed, plus one observed gap (no demo video); size, founder-led status and any named buyer are unverified, so ICP and reachability are held down.
next_action: Coordinator review. If kept, draft a short email that asks (does not assert) whether a launch video is planned, after rechecking groundrule.dev for a video. Ask the human whether a generic hello@ address is acceptable.

segment: Indian dev-tool companies that ship often
fit_reason: Open-source observability company with Indian roots, a public GitHub org and a launch week on 12 to 16 Oct 2026, but funded and already producing walkthrough videos; fails the funded-company disqualifier.

evidence.claim: SigNoz Launch Week 6.0 ran 12 to 16 Oct 2026, with live sessions led by its engineers and CEO and a 'Watch the walkthroughs' option. It already makes video for its launches. Seen 2026-10-30.

Inc42 profile: $5.4M+ raised across 2 rounds, last round dated 27 or 28 Sep 2023; founders Ankit Nayan and Pranay Prateek; headcount shown as 45 in the profile and 14 in the FAQ; HQ listed inconsistently as San Francisco. Seen 2026-10-30.

score_rationale: Fresh launch week but funded, outside the 2 to 20 range on one source and already makes launch videos.
disqualify_reason: Funded product company (about $5.4M raised) that already produces launch-week walkthrough videos; the brief treats funded companies with their own marketing and design as disqualified for now. Headcount sources disagree (14 to 45), HQ appears to be San Francisco, and a security-minded buyer may ask for SSO or SOC 2, which MotionRepo lacks.
